While under detention, the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] was supervised by a [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''guard'''. Trying to escape, Garnet attempted to convince the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[M-3PO (Jarstein)|M-3PO]] to use a [[feather boa]] and wrap it around the guard's breathing slits while he slept. M-3PO's worrying woke the guard.<ref name="RPG" />
